column1: # Human corrections to the LLM's form-to-lemma mapping, applied by
# src/headwords.py build. One per line, tab-separated:
#   form<TAB>lemma<TAB>pos     map the form to this lemma and part of speech
#   form<TAB>-                 drop the form: it makes no entry
# Review candidates come from `mise run headwords-check`.
# 2026-09-25, from the definition review: words that live only inside a
# fixed phrase (a través de, sin embargo, a partir de...) or are not Spanish.
# Part of speech: the forms show the adjective, not the noun or preposition.
# The participle of poner, not a noun of its own.
